defects.description: Time of day changes after the first cut from dark to light
Shifts back to earlier time of day as the man enters
Man enters from what seems like the kitchen of the diner
'Open' sign / interior layout doesn't match the exterior establishing shot
Man seems to bring his own cup for the coffee
Man sitting clipping through the counter as he faces camera; woman is missing
Man shifts to opposite end of the counter
Woman crosses through the counter to sit next to him
Woman changes to the opposite side of him on the reverse shot
Man's hand leaves tip and another of his hands takes it
Two instances of the same woman in the diner
Coffee pours from a carafe whose top half is transparent/empty; solid black liquid mass at bottom (KT-confirmed from model finding, 2026-08-14)
Truck outside changes from white semi (00:00) to dark green box truck at departure (KT-confirmed from model finding, 2026-08-14)
Man's mug has moved position on the counter without visible cause (KT-confirmed from model finding, 2026-08-14)
Red ball duplicates when picked up (2 red -> 3 red); heavy morphing while stirring, up to 5 red visible
Mirrored pose does not match the in-room pose, especially foot position
Shoulder tattoo morphs as she raises her arm
At 00:05 reflection shows hand in front, in-room shows hand behind her back
Implausible interior layout: walking the length of the kitchen through a bedroom reveals another similar kitchen
Bedroom has two chairs tucked under the foot of the bed as if the bed is a table
Coin placed into a cup moves to the outside of the cup
Other hand places a coin on the table and the coin changes into a cup (appearance of 5 cups)
Shot starts with 4 cups, implies 5, ends with 3 visible; gold coins in center of table disappear
Mirror reflection of hair-brushing does not match in-room action (0:04 in-room hand over ear, reflection in front of forehead)
The brush object itself morphs and changes
Screen contains garbled text and hand gestures have no effect on the screen UI
Dark purple olives not visible at start (could feasibly be underneath the green)
Amount poured from first container exceeds what arrives in the jar
First container (bowl) becomes a small bottle when set down
Second batch of olives gathers into his hand unnaturally and a container appears around them
First jump reveals board underside with only two wheels, unnaturally placed
Feet morph together and switch position on the turn
Small details on the watch morph slightly; winding/spinning action seems unusual
Two green blocks become 8 multicolored blocks
Apple held unnaturally: closed hand plus clapping hand, nothing holding it up
Apple disappears after she passes in front of the camera (seen from behind)
Woman's torso pokes out of the hood in front of the windshield (primary defect)
License plate number is garbled
Road topology nonsensical: poles in the middle of the road, lane lines morph
Man has the plated meal at night (00:33-00:44) before the waitress serves it at dawn (01:10) (KT-confirmed 2026-08-14; P3 assigned by Claude)
Magician wears a black bow tie and a red necktie simultaneously (KT-confirmed 2026-08-14; P3 assigned by Claude)
Right hand shows 6 fingers as the camera rotates around it - 5 fingers with no thumb in view until later (KT-identified 2026-08-14; P3 assigned by Claude)
Crates of unnatural teal/cyan fruit at the market stalls (KT-confirmed 2026-08-14; P3 assigned by Claude)
Top-left market sign shows garbled glyphs; KT: very low priority, difficult to see (KT-confirmed 2026-08-14)
Hair streams violently in wind while vegetation and antenna are unaffected (KT-confirmed 2026-08-14; P3 assigned by Claude)

Spoken dialogue references 'the red door is locked, the blue door is open' but all visible doors are brown and closed - audio/visual mismatch (KT-confirmed 2026-08-14 from muse finding; P3 assigned by Claude)
Windshield wiper arms relocate/change configuration between frames (KT-confirmed 2026-08-15: valid but minor)
